newsitem.title: USA: Asahi/America acquires Universal Flow unit.
newsitem.headline: Asahi/America acquires Universal Flow unit.

text.p: Asahi/America Inc said Friday the company has acquired the plastic flow meter division of privately held Universal Flow Monitors Inc.
A purchase price was not disclosed.
The company said assets and intellectual property associated with the company's vortex flow meter product line were included in the purchase.

Asahai said research groups estimate the market for vortex flow meters, a technology for measuring fluid flow through a pipeline where contamination is of concern, at $154 million and project an annual growth rate of five to-seven percent over the next five years.
